attempted_claim: Let A be a unital, simple, separable, non-elementary, nuclear C*-algebra with finite nuclear dimension satisfying the UCT. It is known that A tensor Q has generalized tracial rank at most one (Gong-Lin-Niu). Does A itself have generalized tracial rank at most one, i.e. can the Q-stabilization be removed without assuming finite decomposition rank, real rank zero, or torsion-free K_0?
